title: ::: K-IG 교육 영어듣기훈련프로그램 | 기초2 | 제 001 회 강의 :::
label: [ K-IG 교육 Reading 213 ]

blocks.text: Sue had a newspaper route in her neighborhood. She got up at 5:30 every morning to deliver the newspapers to her customers. She had this job for a year and never missed a day. It did not matter whether it rained or snowed. Her customs were all satisfied because they were always sure they would get the news early in the morning. Sometimes Sue woke up feeling sick. Howeve, she delivered the newspapers not to disappoint her customers.

Robert's friends made fun of him because he could not ride a bicycle, So, Robert wanted to learn how to do it. One afternoon he asked his big brother to teach him. His brother held the bike from behind, and Robert soon became confident. Right after his brother took his hands off the bike, though, he could not balance himself and fell. After the fall, Robert got up and tried again. The same thing happened again and again, which hurt him. Howeve, Robert kept trying and finally learned to ride a bike.

readingSentences.english: Sue had a newspaper route in her neighborhood.
She got up at 5:30 every morning to deliver the newspapers to her customers.
readingSentences.korean: 그녀는 그녀의 고객들을 위해 매일 아침 5시 30분에 신문을 배달하기 위해 일어났다.

readingSentences.english: She had this job for a year and never missed a day.
readingSentences.korean: 그녀는 일 년간 그 일을 했으며 하루도 빼먹지 않았다.

readingSentences.english: It did not matter whether it rained or snowed.
readingSentences.korean: 눈이 오든 비가 오든 상관이 없었다.

readingSentences.english: Her customs were all satisfied because they were always sure they would get the news early in the morning.
readingSentences.korean: 그녀의 고객들은 그들이 아침 일찍이 신문을 받을 것을 확신했었기 때문에 모두 만족했다.

readingSentences.english: Sometimes Sue woke up feeling sick.
Howeve, she delivered the newspapers not to disappoint her customers.
readingSentences.korean: 그러나 그녀는 그녀의 고객들을 실망시키지 않기 위해서 신문을 배달했다.

readingSentences.english: Robert's friends made fun of him because he could not ride a bicycle,
readingSentences.korean: Robert의 친구들은 그가 자전거를 탈줄 몰랐기 때문에 그를 놀렸다.

readingSentences.english: So, Robert wanted to learn how to do it.
readingSentences.korean: 그래서 Robert는 자전거 타는 법을 배우기 원했다.

readingSentences.english: One afternoon he asked his big brother to teach him.
readingSentences.korean: 어느 오후에 그는 그의 큰형에게 가르쳐 달라고 부탁했다.

readingSentences.english: His brother held the bike from behind, and Robert soon became confident.
readingSentences.korean: 그의 형은 자전거를 뒤에서 붙들었고 Robert는 곧 자신감이 생겼다.

readingSentences.english: Right after his brother took his hands off the bike, though, he could not balance himself and fell.
readingSentences.korean: 그러나 그의 형이 자전거에서 손을 놓자마자 Robert는 중심을 잃고 넘어졌다.

readingSentences.english: After the fall, Robert got up and tried again.
readingSentences.korean: 넘어진 후, Robert는 일어나서 다시 시도했다.

readingSentences.english: The same thing happened again and again, which hurt him.
readingSentences.korean: 같은 일은 자꾸자꾸 일어났으며 그리고 그 일들은 그를 다치게 했다.

readingSentences.english: Howeve, Robert kept trying and finally learned to ride a bike.
readingSentences.korean: 그러나 Robert는 계속 노력했으며 결국 자전거 타기를 배웠다.
